notes.title: Launch of Space Dragons, our new shoot 'em up
notes.notes: [p]It’s been a while since we’ve been here, and we’ve been a bit absent. However, we’re back in full force! We’ve just released a new shoot ’em up called [i]Space Dragons[/i].[/p][previewyoutube="rDzc3KstDxc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat that comes from the Moon. Blast your way crushing, ripping apart and exploding hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful weapons and military technology from Earth. Find the entity that controls the threat and make it explode into blood.[/p][p]We invite you to play Space Dragons! — available on Steam [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1862530/Space_Dragons/" style="button" buttoncolor="#b81414"]PLAY[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Greetings everyone, and thank you very much for playing our games.[/p][p]--[/p][p]TEAM Black Hat Robot[/p]

notes.title: Leaderboards corrected
notes.notes: Fixed issue with updating scores to leaderboards. Now it works correctly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you. In addition, we are working on new content and reformulating the mechanics of the game, according to comments and reviews.
